melee.description: The minimum and maximum base damage, dependent on the melee weapon's charge.

The minimum and maximum precision multipliers, dependent on the melee weapon's charge.
Precision multipliers affect the amount that applied damage will deal to the enemy when it is hit in its precision points (typically, head or tumours).

The minimum and maximum stagger multipliers, dependent on the melee weapon's charge.
Stagger multipliers affect the amount that applied damage contributes towards an enemy's 'Stagger HP'.

The minimum and maximum environmental multipliers, dependent on the melee weapon's charge.
Environmental multipliers affect the amount that melee weapons damage the environment, such as weak doors and locks.

The minimum and maximum backstab multipliers, dependent on the melee weapon's charge.
Backstab multipliers affect the damage dealt to an enemy when hitting them from behind.

The minimum and maximum sleeping multipliers, dependent on the melee weapon's charge.
Sleeping multipliers affect the damage dealt to an enemy when they are sleeping.
The minimum and maximum stamina cost of swinging the melee weapon while in combat, dependent on the melee weapon's charge.

melee.name: PushStaminaCost.baseStaminaCostInCombat
melee.description: The stamina cost of performing a 'push' action with the melee weapon while in combat.

The total time (in seconds) to charge the weapon.
Calculated as the sum of the HoldToChargeTime (time that the attack button needs to be held before the weapon starts to charge) and the MaxDamageChargeTime (time to actually charge the weapon).

melee.name: AutoAttackTime
melee.description: Time (in seconds) until the weapon will automatically swing when holding it at full charge.

gun.name: Damage
gun.description: The base damage dealt by this weapon before any multipliers are applied.

gun.name: DefaultClipSize
gun.description: The number of bullets in a single clip.

gun.name: PiercingDamageCountLimit
gun.description:
The number of times this weapon's bullets will pierce.
Note that in vanilla this is quite buggy and the actual number of pierces may be less than this depending on the enemy that was hit.

gun.name: PrecisionDamageMulti
gun.description:
The precision multiplier of the weapon.
Precision multipliers affect the amount that applied damage will deal to the enemy when it is hit in its precision points (typically, head or tumours)

gun.name: StaggerDamageMulti
gun.description:
The stagger multiplier of the weapon.
Stagger multipliers affect the amount that applied damage contributes towards an enemy's 'Stagger HP'

The falloff start and end of the weapon.
From 0m to the falloff start, the weapon will deal full damage.
Between the falloff start and end, the weapon linearly does less damage, with 100% at the start, and 0% at the end.
However, this resulting value is always at least 10% of the weapon's original damage, meaning that the weapon actually reaches its minimum damage value slightly before reaching the falloff end.

gun.name: ShotgunBulletCount
gun.description:
The number of pellets fired from this weapon. Used for shotguns.
When damage calculations are performed against tumours, the tumour damage cap is simulated per-pellet, emulating client-side behaviour.

enemy.name: Health.HealthMax
enemy.description: The maximum health of the enemy.

enemy.name: Health.DamageUntilHitreact
enemy.description:
The amount of damage that needs to be dealt to this enemy for it to stagger. All damage that is dealt to the enemy is multiplied by the weapon's stagger multiplier before being applied here.
Each time the stagger HP reaches zero, the enemy will stagger and it will reset back to the initial value.

enemy.name: Health.WeakspotDamageMulti
enemy.description: A multiplier applied to all damage dealt to this enemy's precision points (typically, head or tumours).

enemy.name: Health.ArmorDamageMulti
enemy.description:
A multiplier applied to all damage that is dealt to this enemy when it is hit in the armor.
For all armored vanilla enemies, this means it is hit in the body instead of its precision points.
Note that due to floating point imprecision in computers, calculations performed with extremely low armor multipliers may not be representative of the real damage values in-game.

enemy.name: Health.BodypartHealth
enemy.description:
The health of each of the enemies limbs. On some enemies, breaking a limb will cause it to stagger.
For enemies with tumours, this is the health of each tumour, where damage caps apply.
The damage dealt to a single tumour with a single bullet can never exceed the health of the tumour + 1, however clients can bypass this restriction with shotgun-type weapons.
